title: Egyptian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by the spices of Egypt, featuring tender cabbage and rich stew.
instructions: Heat butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add Egyptian stew mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add shredded cabbage and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in zesty cabbage spice blend and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
